applicability: Exact checkpoint, frozen implementation and CPU FP32 single-thread execution match.
Query is register-reader bit1; causal bit-axis mixers and rowwise MLPs apply.
No implication is made for pooled heads or higher bit positions.
declared.claim_scope: A source-derived applicability hypothesis transferred from existing evidence; no model or equation evaluated to generate this prediction, no fresh observation and no automatic rule induction.
declared.mechanism: Instruction-conditioned register selectors are identical; register reads and input projection are rowwise. Causal mixers cannot import higher-bit state into the row0/row1 prefix. Rowwise MLPs and the register reader preserve this dependency boundary.
declared.numerical_scope: Native prefix invariance follows from source dependencies. Old intervention payloads used equations conditional on an observed prefix; new payloads use complete raw-input equations. Their prefix bytes may differ, so intervention magnitudes are approximate and their signs are prospective predictions. Retain payload-prefix differences and counterexamples.

structural_prefix_hypothesis.magnitude_scope: Historical intervention payloads were conditional-prefix forecasts. New payloads are full raw-input forecasts; no prefix-byte identity or exact intervention magnitude is presumed.
